title_patterns_that_work: Does [Walk-to-Earn/Payout App] Actually Pay You? (I Checked) #Shorts
Is [Well-Known Platform] Legit or a [Scam/Ticket Scam]? #Shorts
Should You Trust [Recognizable Brand/Service]? (I Checked The Data) #Shorts
title_patterns_to_avoid: Niche or obscure B2B/technical security hooks (e.g., 'Installing a TLS Backdoor')
Long-form deep dives on low-search apps without Shorts pairing (e.g., 'I Checked The Catch You App... Here's Why You Should Wait')
Health supplement verification on obscure products (e.g., 'Does Prevagen Actually Work?')
Passive long-form titles ending with '...(Proof Inside)' or '...(What I Found)'
notes: Shorts heavily outperform long-form across the board, driving almost all view spikes (up to 255 views vs long-form ceiling of 48). Content centered on 'make money / payout verification' (Sweatcoin, WeWard, Cashify, Honeygain) massively outperforms the median of 16 views. High-brand-recognition scam/trust audits also overperform, whereas technical cybersecurity topics and obscure apps fail to gain traction.
